name: chord-detail-notes-spelled
description: G3 S-TONES: the maximized chord detail (Compose > expand) carries a 'Notes:' line spelled in the active key. F major shows Bb D F (never A#). F# major shows A# C# E# for the iii (the E# a pitch-class respell would lose). The vii dim (E#dim = E# G# B) is not buildable in Compose (the voicing packs carry no dim shapes), so that trap is asserted through the exported pure helper in the same page.

steps.label: F major detail: F, Bb, C cards read 'Notes: F A C' / 'Notes: Bb D F' / 'Notes: C E G', no A# anywhere in the notes lines
steps.js: (function(){var t=[].map.call(document.querySelectorAll('#maxGrid .bigNotes'),function(e){return e.textContent});return t.indexOf('Notes: F A C')>=0 && t.indexOf('Notes: Bb D F')>=0 && t.indexOf('Notes: C E G')>=0 && t.join(' ').indexOf('A#')<0})()

steps.label: notes line is not uppercased (Bb stays Bb, not BB)
trap: the vii dim of F# major (token Fdim) spells E# G# B via the same helper
F# major detail: A#m card reads 'Notes: A# C# E#' (E#, never F)
steps.js: (function(){var t=[].map.call(document.querySelectorAll('#maxGrid .bigNotes'),function(e){return e.textContent});return t.indexOf('Notes: F# A# C#')>=0 && t.indexOf('Notes: A# C# E#')>=0 && t.indexOf('Notes: B D# F#')>=0})()
